query: After updating ComfyUI desktop to v0.5.0 (core v0.3.63), LTXV workflow fails: "LTXVBaseSampler 'LTXVPreprocess' object has no attribute 'preprocess'".

desired.outcome: Confirmed by OP: ComfyUI desktop v0.5.1 (core v0.3.64) fixed the LTXV node incompatibility.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Recognize a Desktop v0.5.0 packaging regression breaking LTXV nodes and update to v0.5.1.
